Name: Toothless Dragon Pet
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
[center]﻿Add Toothless to Pelican Town! Discover the downed dragon and bond with it to help.[/center]

This mod adds Toothless as a separate pet, not as a retexture of an existing pet. You can only [b]adopt [/b]Toothless, which means [b]you must select him when you start a new save.

Only the host will be able to see the events.[/b]

Adoption will not occur like normal pets. Marnie will not show up on your porch. [size=3]You will need to earn 1000g AND have met the Wizard for the first time before the [b]first[/b] event triggers. You'll be guided from there. [b]Do not[/b] go to the Cove for the first event. Go there for the [b]second [/b]event. [/size]

Furthermore, you can name Toothless whatever you want. Treat him like any other dragon! All the events/dialogue refer to him as "the dragon" or by your [b]chosen [/b]pet name. If you name him Toothless, the villagers will call him Toothless. If you name him something else, they'll call him that. [b]For ease, I will be referring to him as Toothless on this mod page. 
[/b]
If you don't know the lore of How To Train Your Dragon,[b] you can still play this mod[/b]. I think I gave all the lore I referenced enough context that no prior knowledge is necessary to enjoy the gameplay. 

I do not reference Berk at all, I have not given Toothless a backstory except for missing a tail fin. It's up to you to decide what makes the most sense. 

[b]ADDING TOOTHLESS IN MID-SAVE:[/b]
[spoiler]If you'd like to add Toothless in mid-save, please download the optional file version only. [b]You will need [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997?tab=description]Livestock Bazaar[/url][b]﻿ by mushymato. *Note that the pet will be named Toothless by default, and you will not get access to any events besides the first and a modified text-only version of the adoption event.*[/b] I've not yet figured out a way to modify the events to support the mid-save edition. No guarantee I'll find a way at all. 

The modified event has not been translated, but supports i18n. If you'd like to translate, please contact me through here. 
[/spoiler]

[center]﻿[b]Content Warning: abrupt, loud sound effects during the first two events. Please be advised!![/b][/center]

Downloads.Description:
Allows you to add Toothless in mid-save. The pet will be named Toothless by default. Thank you to mushymato's Livestock Bazaar, which makes this possible.

The adoption event has not been translated, but supports i18n.

Requires Livestock Bazaar.
